uplink.description: fPort 1 standard payload: 25.00 C, 3.60 V, DIN1 asserted (din0 closed), DIN2/DIN3 open
uplink._note: Synthetic, verified against reference/upstream-codec.js parseStandardPayload: temp 12-bit = (bytes[6]&0xf0)>>4=8 | bytes[7]<<4=192 => 200 * 0.125 = 25.0 C (bytes[7] bit7=0 positive); Battery raw = ((bytes[6]&0x0f)=3)<<8 | bytes[5]=132 => 900 * 4 = 3600 mV => 3.6 V; DIN1 = bytes[0] bit0 = 1 -> channels entry din0 'closed' (din1/din2 are the vendor's DIN2/DIN3, both clear).

uplink.description: fPort 1 standard payload: negative -10.00 C, 3.60 V, all three digital inputs open
uplink._note: Synthetic, verified against reference parseStandardPayload below-zero branch: temp 12-bit = 0 | (251<<4)&0xfff = 4016; bytes[7] bit7=1 => (4096-4016)*0.125*-1 = -10.0 C; Battery raw = 3<<8|132 = 900 * 4 = 3600 mV => 3.6 V.

uplink.description: Mixed positions (fPort 1): DIN1 open + DIN2/DIN3 closed, WKUP set, Modbus slot 0 = 0x1234, 42.5 C, 3.60 V
uplink._note: Per-position truth vector, derived from reference/upstream-codec.js parseStandardPayload. bytes[0]=14=0b1110: DIN1=bit0=0 (din0 open), DIN2=bit1=1 (din1 closed), DIN3=bit2=1 (din2 closed), WKUP=bit3=1. Temperature: raw = ((67&0xf0)>>4)=4 | (21<<4)=336 => 340, bytes[7]=21 bit7=0 so positive, 340 * 0.125 = 42.5 C. Battery raw = ((67&0x0f)=3)<<8 | 132 => 900 * 4 = 3600 mV => 3.6 V. Modbus0 = bytes[9]<<8 | bytes[8] = 18<<8 | 52 = 4660 (0x1234).

uplink.description: heartbeat / non-standard payload fPort is not normalized
uplink._note: fPort 10 is the 1.0 heartbeat payload (no unit-defined temperature); this codec only normalizes the fPort 1 standard measurement payload.
